description: Returns one train operator’s Delay Repay rules: the delay at which it starts paying, each payout tier, the claim deadline, the link to its claim form, any automatic or one-click scheme, and the date the rules were last checked against the operator’s own page. Accepts the operator’s name as people say it, such as Avanti, GWR or Southern. No sign-in needed.

operator.description: Train company name as people say it: "Avanti", "GWR", "Southern", "LNER", or a two-letter operator code.

name: get_delay_repay_rules
title: Delay Repay rules for a train operator
